basic_identification.full_title: Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Sanitary Appliances — Code of Practice (Second Revision)
basic_identification.sector_category: Civil Engineering / Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings (approved by the Civil Engineering Division Council and finalized by the Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings Sectional Committee, CED 3, of the Bureau of Indian Standards)

sectional_committee.name: Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings Sectional Committee

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the code of practice for the selection, on-site installation, and maintenance of sanitary appliances in residential, commercial, and public buildings, including water closets, washbasins, urinals, bidets, flushing cisterns, and kitchen sinks to ensure leak-free and hygienic plumbing operations.

certification_and_marking.standard_type: Code of Practice / Technical Guidelines (Civil Engineering Department / Sanitary Appliances)
certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary Code of Practice. Since IS 2064 is an installation code rather than a manufactured physical commodity, it does not carry an individual physical 'ISI Mark' on its own. However, compliance with its dimensional, spacing, and jointing requirements is legally mandatory under municipal corporation building bylaws, State Public Works Department (PWD) specifications, the National Building Code (NBC 2016), and public works tenders across India.

requirements.detail: Every sanitary appliance must discharge through an effective trap (such as P-trap, S-trap, or bottle trap) that maintains a continuous water seal depth of not less than 50 mm to prevent the backflow of toxic sewer gases into habitable spaces.
The standard height for mounting wash basins is 750 mm to 800 mm from the finished floor level to the top rim of the basin, ensuring optimal ergonomic access and minimal water splashing.
Wall-mounted shower heads must be positioned at exactly 2000 mm (2.0 m / 6.5 ft) from the finished floor level, designed to accommodate average adult heights.
Urinal lips of bowl/basin types must be installed at a height of 610 mm from the finished floor level for adults, and lowered to 510 mm for schools and nurseries.
Vitreous water closet bowls of the European pedestal style must be installed such that the top rim is positioned at 400 mm from the finished floor level.
Wash basins and sinks must be rigidly supported on heavy-duty cast iron brackets conforming to IS 775 or fixed directly to walls using high-strength steel rag bolts.
All joints between vitreous china outlets (IS 2556) and lead, PVC, or cast iron waste/soil pipes must be sealed using gas-tight and watertight gaskets, mastic, or cement-hemp packing.
All pressure-tight screwed metal pipe jointing must use threads conforming strictly to the dimensions and tolerances of IS 554.
The overflow pipe from wash basins and sinks must be connected directly to the waste pipe immediately above the inlet of the trap to prevent bypassing of the water seal.

All observed or calculated physical parameters, mounting heights, and clearances must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2:1960. The number of significant places retained should match that of the specified value.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 2064 : 1993 (Second Revision) is the primary national Indian Standard code of practice regulating the selection, site installation, and long-term maintenance of sanitary appliances. Maintained under the Sanitary Appliances and Water Fittings Sectional Committee (CED 3) and reaffirmed in 2022, this standard unifies plumbing layouts across India's domestic and commercial sectors. It unifies high-precision installation dimensions (such as washbasin rim heights at 750–800 mm, European WC seats at 400 mm, and wall showers at 2000 mm from finished floor levels), mandates robust structural brackets, requires watertight and gas-tight jointing to prevent leakages, and enforces a minimum 50 mm deep water seal in all traps to block sewer-gas backflows, ensuring maximum sanitation and public health.
